The present appeal arises out a judgment and order dated 19.08.2025 passed by the learned Judge,
SPL.(CBI) Court No. 3, 2nd SPL, NIA Court & E.D. Court, Calcutta in connection with Regular Case No. 14 of 03 and Special (CBI) Case No. 08 of 11 whereby the Learned Judge was pleased to convict one of the accused persons namely Chandan Biswas in respect of charges of commission of offences under Section 420/468/471/120B of the Indian Penal Code, 1860 and under Section 13(2) of the Prevention of Corruption Act, 1988, and convict the appellants for the offences punishable under Section 420/120B and sentenced the appellants for a term of three years and to pay a fine of Rs.25,000/- each and in default to suffer simple imprisonment for a further period of two months.
